mapper.select: SELECT * FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'NOTIFIED') ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at
SELECT * FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'NOTIFIED') AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at

SELECT * FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND service_id = #{serviceId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AND ( (preferred_date = #{availableDate} OR flexible_date = 1) AND ( (preferred_time_start IS NULL) OR (#{availableTime} BETWEEN preferred_time_start AND preferred_time_end) OR flexible_time = 1 ) ) AND (preferred_resource_id IS NULL OR preferred_resource_id = #{resourceId}) ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'NOTIFIED') AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment_waitlist ( tenant_id, customer_id, service_id, preferred_resource_id, preferred_date, preferred_time_start, preferred_time_end, flexible_date, flexible_time, status, priority, expires_at, created_at, notes ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{serviceId}, #{preferredResourceId}, #{preferredDate}, #{preferredTimeStart}, #{preferredTimeEnd}, #{flexibleDate}, #{flexibleTime}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{expiresAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), #{notes} )
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_waitlist SET preferred_resource_id = #{preferredResourceId}, preferred_date = #{preferredDate}, preferred_time_start = #{preferredTimeStart}, preferred_time_end = #{preferredTimeEnd}, flexible_date = #{flexibleDate}, flexible_time = #{flexibleTime}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, notes = #{notes} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE appointment_waitlist SET status = 'NOTIFIED', notified_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE appointment_waitlist SET status = 'MATCHED', matched_appointment_id = #{appointmentId}, matched_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE appointment_waitlist SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'NOTIFIED') AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'NOTIFIED') AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP())
